g.text: 36.4816 V before D7; approximately 36 V at VM under load. No output boost below dropout.

g.text: 6 A converter design target; 2.54mm headers limit the path to at most 3 A; jumper leads may be lower. Initial bring-up: <=2 A.

g.text: AUTO mode / internal compensation. Loop stability, cooling and load transients require bench verification.

g.text: SW4 is internally connected to SW1/2/3 in U5. BAT_SW_BOOT keeps the bootstrap return local; do not route it around the inductor.
